title: Beyond Rigid Hands: Deforming Skin into Contact-Consistent Hand Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2611.31950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hands grasp objects with soft skin. A fingertip flattens against a mug, and a palm curves around a bottle. Yet hand-object datasets and estimators represent the hand as a rigid articulated mesh, which hovers above or penetrates the object where skin would press against it. Existing refiners keep the mesh rigid and adjust only the pose, trading pose accuracy for physical plausibility. We ask whether a rigid hand can instead touch the object as skin does while staying close to its original pose. We lift annotated or estimated rigid hands to contact-consistent meshes through an optimization that (i) slightly adjusts the joints and wrist to bring the fingers onto the object, (ii) deforms the skin so that penetrating regions settle onto the surface, and (iii) keeps this deformation consistent over time. Since deformation reaches only skin already near the object, we further train a lightweight head on the lifted annotations to predict where

translated_title: 超越刚性手部：将皮肤变形为接触一致的手部网格
translated_abstract: 双手通过柔软的皮肤抓握物体：指尖贴在马克杯上会变平，手掌环绕瓶子时会弯曲。然而，现有的手-物体数据集和估计器将手表示为刚性铰接网格，在皮肤本应紧贴物体的地方，网格会悬浮在物体上方或穿透物体。现有的细化方法保持网格刚性、仅调整姿态，以姿态精度换取物理合理性。我们提出这样一个问题：刚性手能否像皮肤那样接触物体，同时保持接近其原始姿态。我们通过一种优化方法将带标注或估计的刚性手提升为接触一致的网格，该优化方法：，微调关节和手腕，使手指贴合到物体上， 将皮肤变形，使穿透区域沉降到物体表面上， 保持该变形在时间上的一致性。由于变形仅作用于已靠近物体的皮肤区域，我们进一步在提升得到的标注上训练一个轻量级预测头，以预测哪里（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种优化方法，通过微调关节姿态并将皮肤变形贴合到物体表面且保持时间一致性，将刚性手部网格提升为接触一致的手部网格，并训练轻量级预测头来自动预测变形区域。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimization-based method that lifts rigid hand meshes into contact-consistent meshes by slightly adjusting joints and deforming skin onto object surfaces with temporal consistency, along with a lightweight prediction head to infer deformation regions.
